correctness.rationale: For the repaired claim, aggregation at the reset destination and class masses 1/(2-r), (1-r)/(2-r) yield the observed-row formula and endpoint values. Revealing the Bernoulli indicator gives a pointwise upper envelope U, with conditional-entropy loss at most (1-r)/m times log(ea/b) before class weighting. At scale s=(m^3 n)^(-1/4) this loss is O(log m/m)=o(s), and the normalized envelope converges uniformly on compact sets to t(1-log t). U''<0 up to m^(-1/2); U'<0 thereafter by the 5/9 lower bound on the log m coefficient up to 1/2, then by its sign. Strict envelope barriers at (1±ε)s below the actual value at s localize every maximizer, and compact convergence gives the gain. In the original proportional regime the compact profile instead uses m(log m-g_m)→(1+t)log(1+t)-t and the same envelope excludes all r≥T/m for large fixed T. The proof, not the frozen script's reported finite assertions, supplies both infinite limits; no finite-size uniqueness or external attestation is claimed.
